mapper.select: select ci.*, p.title, p.price as product_price, p.original_price, p.sales, p.stock, p.tag, p.skus, p.on_sale, p.deleted, s.name as shop_name, s.score as shop_score from cart_items ci join products p on p.id = ci.product_id and p.deleted = 0 left join shops s on s.shop_id = p.shop_id where ci.user_id = #{userId} order by ci.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into cart_items(user_id, product_id, sku, quantity, price ,created_at ,updated_at) values (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{sku}, #{quantity}, #{price}, now(), now()) on duplicate key update quantity = least(999,quantity + #{quantity}), price = coalesce(#{price}, price),updated_at = now()
